patterns: Ports dominate: port-to-state (Haldia WB, Kandla Gujarat), west vs east coast, natural vs artificial (Chennai artificial), tidal Kandla, JNPT decongests Mumbai, Paradip for Kolkata-Visakhapatnam.
APPSC items: Suez links Mediterranean-Red Sea, Quilon not a major west-coast port, USA largest export destination, India does not import iron ore, milk products not an export.
Chokepoints asked as 'which strait connects X and Y' (Bab-el-Mandeb, Bering, Malacca-Singapore, SUMED statement pair).
Commodity-trade items are older-data single facts (gems then chemicals in 2002-03; vegetable oils top agri import; pulses largest producer/consumer/importer).
App leans on FY26 statistics, FTA-year matching and 2026 chokepoint news; PYQs rarely ask figures beyond port/strait identification.
